answer.value: Evaluated with two open-source frameworks: Microsoft's Eureka ML Insights (internal development benchmarks and ablations; MathVista, MMMU-CoT, ScreenSpot/ScreenSpot-V2, ScreenSpot-Pro, V*Bench) and VLMEvalKit (standardized community benchmarks such as AI2D, ChartQA, DocVQA, MMMU, OCRBench). Comparisons were also run with forced nothink/thinking modes. Shots and prompts are not stated.
quotes: Two evaluation frameworks were used: Microsoft's Eureka ML Insights for internal development benchmarks, and VLMEvalKit for standardized community benchmarks.
